title: Patch: recalibrate the ladder bots' seeds for AI generation 13

**Issue #1680 (data, not instructions):**

`````text
# #1680: Patch: recalibrate the ladder bots' seeds for AI generation 13
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## Why

The ladder bots' seed ratings were calibrated on AI generation 9 (`BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION = 9`, `crates/server/src/config.rs`). The AI is now generation 13, the learned evaluation (#1477). `docs/bot-calibration.md` (After an AI promotion) asks for a recalibration after each promotion. #1336 asked for this one, and is closed with the rest of it done.

Bots already in the pool are covered: since #1560 a bot's first rated game on a new generation widens its deviation, so its rating moves to the new AI (R1560000). What is left is the seeds that new bots start from.

## Proposal

Follow `docs/bot-calibration.md`, After an AI promotion:

1. On `main`, run `cargo run --release -p jackioh-server -- bot-calibrate`. It adds each promotion's `vsParent` Elo since generation 9, from `training/history/*.jsonl`, to the reference's seed of record. If `bot-calibrate-live` has measured the anchor since, pass `--anchor=<rating>` instead.
2. Compare the printed seeds with the skill curve's, and put the report into the doc's Results either way.
3. Then one of:
   - the seeds stay within the measurements' error: set `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` to 13;
   - they move outside it: paste the printed `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` row and the matching `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` rows, and set `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` to 13.

   Use `--games=300` when the call is close.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `docs/bot-calibration.md`'s Results has generation 13's report.
- [ ] `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` is 13, and the seeds moved only if the report shows they should.
- [ ] `apps/web/src/wire/serverConfig.ts` is regenerated if a constant the client reads changed (`crates/server/tests/export_config.rs`).
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-server` and every required check are green.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/39850480469)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Generation 13's calibration report goes into `docs/bot-calibration.md`'s Results, and `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` becomes 13.

The planner ran `cargo run --release -p jackioh-server -- bot-calibrate` on base `bcb8030c1` (4 threads, about 23 minutes of games after a 6-minute build). The offsets agree with the skill curve's gaps. The anchor, though, moved +632.4: the seed of record 1200 plus the `vsParent` Elo of generations 10–13. So every printed seed is 571–632 Elo above the curve. That is far outside both measurements' error, so the issue's second branch applies:
- the printed `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` row goes in, with the same readings over `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`;
- `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` (the table's last row) becomes the reference's 1832.

No constant the client reads changes, so `apps/web/src/wire/serverConfig.ts` is not regenerated: `crates/server/tests/export_config.rs` exports none of these four constants.

## Files to touch

| Path | Kind | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/server/src/config.rs` | change | The values of `BOT_SEED_RATINGS`, `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION`, `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` and `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`. The doc comments of `BOT_SEED_RATINGS`, `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` and `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` |
| `docs/bot-calibration.md` | change | The "Provisional" bullet. In Results: a new "Generation 13" section, and a "Generation 9" heading over the old run |
| `crates/server/README.md` | change | "Skill to Elo": the anchor's sentence, plus one paragraph under the table |
| `spec/rulings/R748000.md` | change | The **Anchor** sentence, plus one sentence in **Seeds** |
| `spec/rulings/R1454.md` | change | Line 13: the 570 and 1200 seed figures |
| `spec/rulings/R1555000.md` | change | Line 37: "measured at 1200" |

Do not touch:
- any test, `apps/` or `e2e/`;
- `crates/engine`, `crates/ai` or `crates/ai/generation.json`;
- `crates/cards` (no patches fragment: no card plays differently);

Add one doc line after line 1118: `/// The row is generation 13's calibration, pasted over the curve's too (docs/bot-calibration.md, Results).`
   - b. Line 1190 becomes `pub const BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION: i64 = 13;`
   - c. Replace lines 1220–1224 (the `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` doc and constant) with:
     ```rust
     /// R747000, R748000: the Elo the reference, this build's AI at full skill, is held at in
     /// `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`, and the strongest bot's seed: 1200 from R1454 until generation 13's calibration

In its doc comment, replace "A new best AI, or a set that ships, is measured again by the same protocol and the rows pasted over; the live Glicko ratings (R603) are the ongoing calibration." with "A new best AI, or a set that ships, is measured again by the same protocol and the rows pasted over, or by R748000's calibration, whose readings of the strengths as built are the rows since generation 13 (docs/bot-calibration.md, Results); the live Glicko ratings (R603) are the ongoing calibration." Rewrap to at most 110 columns, like the neighbouring lines.

3. **`docs/bot-calibration.md`:**
   - a. In the "Provisional" bullet (lines 52–54), replace "`SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` (1200): the value the strongest strength was given by hand, and the one the skill curve is held at (R747000)." with "`SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR`: 1200, the value the strongest strength was given by hand, until generation 13's calibration moved it to 1832 (Results), and the one the skill curve is held at (R747000)." Keep the line wrapping style.
   - b. Directly under `## Results`, before "Run on 2026-10-13…", insert the block below.
     - Fill in `<date>` (`date -u +%F`), and `<N>` and `<M>` from step 1.
     - Paste `/tmp/calib-1680.md` verbatim where marked.
     - Then put `### Generation 9 (issue #748)` and a blank line before "Run on 2026-10-13". Leave the rest of the generation 9 text unchanged.

     ````markdown
     ### Generation 13 (issue #1680)

     Run on <date> on `main` at `bcb8030c1` (generation 13, the learned evaluation, #1477), from the repo root:

     ```sh
     cargo run --release -p jackioh-server -- bot-calibrate
     ```

     (100 games per pair, the default), on <N> threads, in about <M> minutes. `bot-calibrate-live` has
     still not been run, so the anchor is the seed of record, 1200, shifted by the four promotions after
     generation 9 in `training/history`: generations 10, 11 and 12 of the unban lane (72, 80 and 76 of
     100) and 13 of the learn lane (220 of 400). The report is the command's output, unedited.

     <paste /tmp/calib-1680.md here>

     ### Reading generation 13 against the curve

     | Strength | Curve | Calibration | Difference | Difference in its ±'s |
     | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
     | 0 (skill 0) | 570 | 1201 | +631 | 23.4 |
     | 1 (skill 0.25) | 740 | 1370 | +630 | 28.4 |
     | 2 (skill 0.5) | 900 | 1512 | +612 | 28.9 |
     | 3 (skill 0.75) | 1080 | 1651 | +571 | 25.7 |
     | 4 (skill 1) | 1200 | 1832 | +632 | |

     - **The offsets agree with the curve.** Measured from the reference, the curve's rows stand 630, 460, 300
       and 120 below it, and the calibration's offsets are 631.6, 462.5, 320.5 and 181.4. Strengths 0 to 2
       are within one standard error. Strength 3 is 61 Elo lower (2.8 of its ±'s), about the curve's own
       50 Elo error. Three games of 1000 were unfinished.
     - **The anchor moved 632.4 Elo.** Every seed is 571 to 632 above the curve because of the
       promotions' `vsParent` alone. That is far past both measurements' error, so the seeds move: the printed
       row goes over `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` and the same readings over `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`, the reference's 1832
       becomes `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR`, and `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` becomes 13. No `--games=300` run was needed:
       more games narrow the ±'s, not a 571 Elo gap.
     - **What it does not tell.** A promotion's `vsParent` overstates its gain against people (How
       calibration differs from live play). The random policy, strength 0, plays as it did at generation
       9, yet its seed rises 631: it won 1 of its 100 games against the reference, too lopsided a score
       to show how much stronger the reference became. Only new bots start from these seeds. Bots already in
       the pool keep their ratings and re-settle on generation 13 through their own games (R1560000), and
       `bot-calibrate-live` replaces the anchor once the reference has played people.

   - In **Seeds**, right after "a person's decision (`docs/bot-calibration.md`, Results)." and before "Seeds are for new bots only", insert: " At generation 13 (issue #1680) the offsets agreed with the curve's gaps to within 61 Elo, and the anchor, the seed of record shifted 632 Elo by the promotions of generations 10 to 13, put every seed 571 to 632 above the curve, so the printed row went over `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` and the curve's rows, and the reference's 1832 into `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR`."

7. **`spec/rulings/R1555000.md`** line 37: change "measured at 1200 (`SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR`, [[R748000]])" to "measured at 1832 (`SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR`, [[R748000]])".

8. Check that nothing else still states the old anchor: `grep -rn "1200" spec/rulings/R748000.md spec/rulings/R1454.md spec/rulings/R1555000.md crates/server/src/config.rs crates/server/README.md`. The only hits left should be:
   - the historical "1200 until/before" wording;

## Tests

No new test. The existing tests already hold the new values:
- each seed equals the curve's reading;
- the table's last row equals `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR`, and the rows ascend;
- the ceiling is the highest seed.

R748000 rejects a test that ties `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` to `crates/ai/generation.json`, so do not add one.

The tests that hold the values:
- `crates/server/tests/bots/seat.rs`: `r747000_strength_seed_ratings_match_skill_curve`, `r747000_expected_elo_reads_the_table_by_straight_lines`
- `crates/server/tests/bots/calibrate.rs`: `r748000_the_strengths_seed_from_bot_seed_ratings` and the other `r748000_*`
- `crates/server/tests/api/bots.rs`: `r748000_the_strongest_seed_is_the_ceiling` (a person at 1833 gets no bot; one at 1832 gets the strongest)
- `crates/server/tests/bots/pool.rs`: `r750000_bot_target_strength_runs_from_the_weakest_to_the_strongest`

Commands:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server -- r747000 r748000 r750000` (19 tests; all pass on the base)
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server`
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` (expect no card that plays differently, so no fragment)

## Done when

- [ ] Step 1's run is finished, and its output is pasted unedited into Results with its date, threads and minutes.
- [ ] `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` is 13, and `BOT_SEED_RATINGS`, `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` and `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` hold the printed readings.
- [ ] The docs and the three rulings say 1832 and 1201 where they stated the old seeds. `spec/INDEX.md` is unchanged.
- [ ] `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire` is empty after `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`.
- [ ] The commands above are green, and so are the harness checks: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests and web tests. Name any red check in the report.
- [ ] The report records the decision (the seeds moved) and the rejected alternative (Open questions).

## Risks

- **Running after the edit** prints "the seed of record 1832.0, no promotion since generation 13". The seeds come out the same, but the report then describes the anchor wrongly. That is why step 1 comes first.
- **Determinism:** the server is not a pure crate, and no replay or golden reads these constants. Only two things read them:
  - new bots' `bot_ratings` seeds (`bots::pool::draw_new_bot`);
  - `bot_target_strength`, whose shares change slightly because it is a rating fraction. Its test is generic.
- **Pairing:** every strength's new-bot seed is now above `RATING_START` (1000), the random-policy bot's included. The top seed, which is the fresh pool's ceiling (R1453), is 1832. Bots already in the pool are untouched (R748000, R1560000).
- **Hidden information and client contract:** no risk. The client reads none of these constants.

## Open questions

- **Move the seeds or keep them (a person may overrule before the build).** The plan follows the issue's rule as written: the printed seeds are outside the error, so they are pasted in.
  - The rejected alternative: keep the seeds at the curve and only set `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` to 13. That is step 2b plus step 3, with the decision bullet reading "the seeds stay at the curve".
  - The case for keeping them: the offsets match the curve, and the whole gap is the summed `vsParent`, which the doc and R1560000 say overstates gains against people. Also, the random-policy bot's seed would rise from 570 to 1201 although its play never changed.
  - The cost of keeping them: the +632 shift is dropped for good, because the next calibration starts from 1200 at generation 13.
  - If a person prefers to keep them, they edit this plan before the build.
- The `difficulty:medium` rating fits: the change touches spec notes, docs and one crate, with no engine, AI or migration work.
`````
